mapper.insert: INSERT INTO run_material_effect_declaration (tenant_id, run_id, node_key, effect_index, declaration, declaration_hash, workflow_ver) VALUES (#{t}, #{runId}, #{nodeKey}, #{effectIndex}, #{declaration}::jsonb, #{hash}, #{workflowVer}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, run_id, node_key, effect_index) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO plate_material_effect (tenant_id, source_run_id, source_node_key, source_loop_index, effect_index, source_attempt, plate_id, declaration, declaration_hash, payload_hash, target_snapshot, resolution_evidence, expected_state_version, expected_process_state, expected_seal_state, status) VALUES (#{t}, #{runId}, #{nodeKey}, #{loopIndex}, #{effectIndex}, #{attempt}, #{plateId}, #{declaration}::jsonb, #{declHash}, #{payloadHash}, #{targetSnapshot}::jsonb, #{resolutionEvidence}::jsonb, #{expectedStateVersion}, #{expectedProcessState}, #{expectedSealState}, #{status}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, source_run_id, source_node_key, source_loop_index, effect_index) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO plate_material_effect_action (tenant_id, effect_id, action_type, from_status, to_status, actor_type, operator_user_id, reason, evidence_snapshot, error_code) VALUES (#{t}, #{effectId}, #{actionType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{actorType}, #{operatorUserId}, #{reason}, #{evidenceSnapshot}::jsonb, #{errorCode})

INSERT INTO plate_material_event (tenant_id, plate_id, effect_id, event_type, from_process_state, to_process_state, from_seal_state, to_seal_state, changed_fields, from_state_version, to_state_version, source_run_id, source_node_key, source_loop_index, command_id, evidence, evidence_level, evidence_snapshot, operator_type, operator_user_id, note, occurred_at) VALUES (#{t}, #{plateId}, #{effectId}, #{eventType}, #{fromProcessState}, #{toProcessState}, #{fromSealState}, #{toSealState}, #{changedFields}::jsonb, #{fromStateVersion}, #{toStateVersion}, #{sourceRunId}, #{sourceNodeKey}, #{sourceLoopIndex}, #{commandId}, #{evidence}, #{evidenceLevel}, #{evidenceSnapshot}::jsonb, #{operatorType}, #{operatorUserId}, #{note}, #{occurredAt}::timestamptz)
mapper.select: SELECT declaration AS "declaration", declaration_hash AS "declarationHash" FROM run_material_effect_declaration WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND run_id = #{runId} AND node_key = #{nodeKey} AND effect_index = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT status AS "status", plate_id AS "plateId", expected_state_version AS "expectedStateVersion", expected_process_state AS "expectedProcessState", expected_seal_state AS "expectedSealState", source_run_id AS "sourceRunId", source_node_key AS "sourceNodeKey", source_loop_index AS "sourceLoopIndex", declaration AS "declaration", declaration_hash AS "declarationHash", payload_hash AS "payloadHash", last_error_code AS "lastErrorCode" FROM plate_material_effect WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{effectId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT process_state AS "processState", seal_state AS "sealState", state_version AS "stateVersion" FROM plate WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{plateId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE plate SET process_state = #{processState}, seal_state = #{sealState}, state_version = #{newStateVersion}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{plateId}
UPDATE run_node SET material_sync_status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND run_id = #{runId} AND node_key = #{nodeKey} AND loop_index = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM plate_material_effect WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= now()) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE plate_material_effect SET apply_attempt_count = apply_attempt_count + 1, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, last_attempt_at = now(), next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}::timestamptz, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{effectId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE plate_material_effect SET plate_id = #{plateId}, expected_state_version = #{expectedStateVersion}, status = 'PENDING', resolution_evidence = resolution_evidence || jsonb_build_object('reconciled', true, 'confirmedPlateId', #{plateId}), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{effectId} AND status = 'NEEDS_RECONCILIATION'

UPDATE plate_material_effect SET expected_state_version = #{expectedStateVersion}, status = 'PENDING', resolution_evidence = resolution_evidence || jsonb_build_object('rebased', true), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{effectId} AND status = 'FAILED'
